mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises in the same month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high consumer credit growth, a decline in residential construction permits signals an impending slowdown in housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior three months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO increases for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits fall below 1300 thousand units in a month, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit outstanding over the prior three months indicates rising consumer spending capacity, which supports corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
